title: How do non-equity instruments shape the financing paths of academic start-ups?
The OECD Start-ups Database: A new lens on the global entrepreneurial ecosystems
Do carbon offsets offset carbon?
abstract: We develop and implement a new method for identifying wasted subsidies, and use it to provide systematic evidence on the misallocation of carbon offsets in the Clean Development Mechanism—the world’s largest carbon offset program. Using newly constructed data on the locations and characteristics of 1,350 wind farms in India—a context where it was believed, ex ante, that the Clean Development Mechanism could significantly increase development above baseline projections—we estimate that at least 52% of approved carbon offsets were allocated to projects that would very likely have been built anyway. In addition to wasting scarce resources, we estimate that the sale of these offsets to regulated polluters has substantially increased global carbon dioxide emissions.
abstract_zh: 我们开发并实施了一种识别无效补贴的新方法，并利用它系统地提供了清洁发展机制（Clean Development Mechanism）中碳抵消额度错配的证据——该机制是全球最大的碳抵消计划。利用新构建的印度1,350座风电场的位置和特征数据——在这一情境下，事前普遍认为清洁发展机制可以显著促进超出基线预测的发展——我们估计，至少52%的已批准碳抵消额度被分配给了很可能无论如何都会建成的项目。除了浪费稀缺资源之外，我们估计，将这些抵消额度出售给受监管的污染者，已大幅增加了全球二氧化碳排放。

title: Fighting climate change: International attitudes toward climate policies
abstract: This paper explores global perceptions and understanding of climate change and policies, examining factors that influence support for climate action and the impact of different types of information. We conduct large-scale surveys with 40,000 respondents from 20 countries, providing new international data on attitudes toward climate change and respondents’ socioeconomic backgrounds and lifestyles. We identify three key perceptions affecting policy support: perceived effectiveness of policies in reducing emissions, their impact on low-income households, and their effect on respondents’ households (self-interest). Educational videos clarifying policy mechanisms increase support for climate policies; those merely highlighting climate change’s impacts do not. (JEL C83, D83, D91, Q54, Q58)
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了全球对气候变化及其政策的认知与理解，考察了影响气候行动支持度的因素，以及不同类型信息的影响。我们在20个国家对40,000名受访者开展了大规模调查，提供了关于人们对气候变化的态度及其社会经济背景和生活方式的新的国际数据。我们识别出影响政策支持度的三种关键认知：对政策减排效果的感知、政策对低收入家庭影响的感知，以及政策对受访者自身家庭（自身利益）影响的感知。阐明政策机制的教育视频能够提高对气候政策的支持；而仅强调气候变化影响的视频则没有此效果。（JEL C83, D83, D91, Q54, Q58）

title: Induced Automation Innovation: Evidence from Firm-Level Patent Data
Policing carbon markets
abstract: Carbon markets have emerged in recent decades as one of the most important tools for curbing industrial greenhouse gas emissions, but they present a number of novel enforcement challenges as compared to more conventional pollution regulations. To shed light on the practical issues involved in policing carbon markets, this study presents the first comprehensive analysis of the EU Emissions Trading System, a single programme that was policed by up to 31 different national regulators. Since 2006, 98.8% of installations in the EU ETS have complied with the regulation according to official data. The observed non-compliance should have resulted in €13 billion in total fines, but only €2.1 billion appear to have been collected. More generally, variation in the probability and severity of fines across national jurisdictions and time explain just one-tenth of the variation in compliance rates. This pattern of high rates of compliance coupled with low rates of enforcement is known in the literature as ‘Harrington’s paradox’. Meanwhile, other enforcement strategies that have been pointed to as resolutions to Harrington’s paradox in other applications, such as ‘naming and shaming’, appear to have had little discernible effect. Therefore, resolving Harrington’s paradox in the context of cap and trade regulation remains a fruitful area for future research.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，碳市场已成为遏制工业温室气体排放最重要的工具之一，但与传统的污染监管相比，它们在执法方面面临许多新的挑战。为阐明碳市场执法中的实际问题，本研究首次对欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）进行了全面分析，该体系由多达31个不同的国家监管机构共同执行。自2006年以来，根据官方数据，EU ETS中98.8%的设施遵守了规定。应有的违规罚款总额本应达到130亿欧元，但实际似乎只征收了21亿欧元。更一般地说，各国司法管辖区之间罚款的概率和严厉程度的差异，以及时间上的变化，仅能解释合规率差异的十分之一。这种高合规率与低执法率并存的现象，在文献中被称为“哈林顿悖论”。与此同时，在其他应用中被认为可以解决哈林顿悖论的其他执法策略，例如“点名批评”，似乎收效甚微。因此，在总量控制与交易制度背景下解决哈林顿悖论，仍是未来研究的一个富有成果的领域。

title: A comprehensive overview of the Energy Intensive Industries ecosystem
abstract: The Energy Intensive Industries (EIIs) ecosystem is a cornerstone of OECD economies due to its role as a critical supplier to many other sectors and its importance for decarbonisation objectives. This paper provides new evidence on the characteristics of, and the main challenges faced by, the EIIs ecosystem across the world, primarily comparing the European Union (EU) with other major regions. The analysis relies on an array of data sources including global input-output tables (ICIO), trade in value added (TiVA), energy prices, international product-level trade data, patent data and skills and job openings. It then maps the existing policies supporting the ecosystem and provides recommendations that can help policymakers better articulate industrial strategies for EIIs.
abstract_zh: 能源密集型产业（EII）生态系统是经合组织（OECD）经济体的基石，因为它是许多其他部门的关键供应商，并且对脱碳目标至关重要。本文提供了关于全球EII生态系统特征及其面临主要挑战的新证据，主要将欧盟与其他主要地区进行比较。分析依托于多种数据来源，包括全球投入产出表（ICIO）、增加值贸易（TiVA）数据、能源价格、国际产品层面的贸易数据、专利数据，以及技能与职位空缺数据。随后，本文梳理了支持该生态系统的现有政策，并提出了有助于政策制定者更好地阐明能源密集型产业战略的建议。

title: Carbon Border Adjustments: The potential effects of the EU CBAM along the supply chain
Climate policy uncertainty and firms' and investors' behavior
Did the COVID-19 crisis uplift business dynamics and venture capital financing?
Digital and green spillovers across firm-level production networks in Estonia
abstract: This paper leverages a unique combination of firm-to-firm transaction and survey data from Estonia to show the importance of network effects for the green and digital transition. This paper shows that the most central firms are also the most energy-productive and digital-intensive, even when controlling for capital-intensity and labour productivity, within sectors and size categories. Using two event studies, the 2018 EU-ETS reform and the 2020 COVID-19 crisis, this paper presents causal evidence that energy productivity and digital technology adoption diffuse through the production network. The diffusion of energy productivity only goes downstream, probably through a price effect. By contrast, the diffusion of digital technologies goes in both directions and mostly upstream (i.e. firms start resembling their buyers). The heterogeneity analysis suggests network effects are a force of convergence, helping firms who are relatively less energy-productive or digital-intensive catch up with the leaders.
abstract_zh: 本文利用爱沙尼亚独特的企业间交易数据与调查数据相结合，展示了网络效应对绿色与数字转型的重要性。本文表明，即使在控制了资本密集度和劳动生产率、并在行业和规模类别内部进行比较之后，网络中最具中心地位的企业同样也是能源生产率最高、数字密集度最高的企业。利用2018年欧盟碳排放交易体系改革和2020年新冠危机这两项事件研究，本文提供了因果证据，表明能源生产率和数字技术的采用会在生产网络中扩散。能源生产率的扩散只向下游进行，可能是通过价格效应实现的。相比之下，数字技术的扩散是双向的，且主要向上游进行（即企业越来越像其买家）。异质性分析表明，网络效应是一种趋同力量，有助于那些能源生产率或数字密集度相对较低的企业追赶领先者。

title: How can the digital transformation affect the net-zero transition? A conceptual framework for the "twin" transition
Productivity among firms patenting in fourth industrial revolution technologies: A focus on Canadian firms
The great dispersion in energy productivity between firms
abstract: This paper explores the differences between firms’ energy productivity using representative microdata for nine countries. It documents wide dispersion in energy productivity across firms within narrowly defined industries. On average, the 90th percentile firm is 20 times more energy productive than the 10th percentile firm in the same industry, compared with five times for labour productivity. There is no sign that this dispersion is narrowing down over time. Addressing this dispersion could have major implications: for example, raising the energy productivity of the least productive firms to that of the 25th percentile firm in their industry would reduce aggregate energy consumption (and associated emissions) by almost half for the same level of output. Machine learning and regression methods reveal a strong link between economic and energy efficiency. Higher energy prices, stronger competition, better access to finance and greater innovation activity also explain dispersion, suggesting a role for policies.
abstract_zh: 本文利用九个国家具有代表性的微观数据，探讨了企业之间能源生产率的差异。研究记录到，在狭义定义的行业内，企业的能源生产率存在巨大离散度。平均而言，同一行业中处于第90百分位的企业，其能源生产率是第10百分位企业的20倍，而劳动生产率的对应差距为5倍。这种离散度没有随时间推移而缩小的迹象。解决这种离散问题可能产生重大影响：例如，将生产率最低的企业的能源生产率提高到其所在行业第25百分位企业的水平，在产出不变的情况下，可使总能源消耗（及相关排放）减少近一半。机器学习和回归方法揭示了经济效率与能源效率之间的紧密联系。较高的能源价格、更激烈的竞争、更好的融资渠道以及更活跃的创新活动，也可以解释这种离散现象，这表明政策具有一定作用。

title: The impact of air pollution on labour productivity: Large-scale micro evidence from Europe
abstract: This study provides causal estimates of the impact of air pollution on short-run productivity based on firm-level data covering over 2.5 million companies operating in Europe from 2000 to 2022. Using the changes in the height of the planetary boundary layer as an instrumental variable, the analysis shows that a 1 µg/m3 increase in PM2.5 concentration (a 7% increase at the sample mean) causes a 0.55% reduction in labour productivity that same year. The effect is driven by high air pollution days above at least 25 µg/m3. Firms in the construction sector and in sectors employing a larger share of high-skilled workers, medium-sized firms, and firms with low capital intensity are more affected. The results suggest that public policies to reduce air pollution may contribute positively to economic growth: back-of-the-envelope simulations suggest that around a third of labour productivity growth in Europe over the period 2011-2022 could have been due to improvements in air quality.
abstract_zh: 本研究基于2000至2022年间在欧洲运营的250多万家企业的企业层面数据，提供了空气污染对短期生产率影响的因果估计。以大气边界层高度的变化作为工具变量，分析表明，PM2.5浓度每增加1 µg/m3（相当于样本均值的7%），当年劳动生产率便下降0.55%。这一效应主要由PM2.5超过至少25 µg/m3的高污染日所驱动。建筑业、高技能劳动力占比较高的行业、中型企业以及资本密集度较低的企业受到的影响更大。研究结果表明，减少空气污染的公共政策可能对经济增长产生积极作用：粗略的模拟显示，2011至2022年间欧洲劳动生产率增长的约三分之一可能归因于空气质量的改善。

title: Understanding Government Venture Capital: A primer and a taxonomy
Venture capital, innovation and business success in cleantech startups: The new green economy
abstract: Startups play a pivotal role in driving innovation and can significantly contribute to the transition toward an environmentally sustainable economy. This paper presents new evidence on the creation, performance, and innovation activity of green startups—those offering goods and services relevant to the green transition—over the period 2010–2022. While the share of green startups has grown modestly overall, venture capital investment in green startups increased considerably in recent years, peaking at around EUR 74 billion globally in 2021. The econometric analysis shows that green startups are more likely to secure VC, receive grants, and innovate than non-green startups. They nonetheless take longer to secure VC and are less likely to do so at the seed stage. Grants attract private investment, especially for green firms, and clean tech patenting is associated with improved funding outcomes. Green startups are less likely to go public and tend to take longer to exit, suggesting scale-up challenges that may warrant targeted policy support.
abstract_zh: 初创企业在推动创新方面发挥着关键作用，并可以为向环境可持续经济的转型作出重大贡献。本文就2010至2022年间绿色初创企业（即提供与绿色转型相关的商品和服务的企业）的创立、绩效和创新活动，提供了新的证据。虽然绿色初创企业的份额总体上温和增长，但近年来风险投资对绿色初创企业的投资大幅增加，2021年在全球范围内达到约740亿欧元的峰值。计量分析表明，与非绿色初创企业相比，绿色初创企业更有可能获得风险投资、获得补助并进行创新。然而，它们获得风险投资所需的时间更长，并且在种子阶段获得风险投资的可能性更低。补助能够吸引私人投资，对绿色企业尤其如此；清洁技术专利的申请则与更好的融资结果相关。绿色初创企业上市的可能性较低，退出所需的时间也往往更长，这表明其在规模扩张方面面临挑战，可能需要有针对性的政策支持。

title: A comprehensive overview of the renewable energy industrial ecosystem
abstract: While renewable energy adoption has accelerated globally, significant challenges remain in meeting ambitious deployment targets. This paper analyses bottlenecks in the renewable energy ecosystem and explores policy solutions by examining trade, innovation, M&A, jobs, and skills data. The analysis reveals three key findings: first, the renewable energy ecosystem spans multiple sectors beyond electricity production, with machinery, computer and electronics, and scientific and technical activities playing central roles in innovation activity and job creation; second, supply chain concentration is increasing for both capital goods and critical raw materials, creating dependencies on key supplier countries; and third, while innovation offers a pathway to address these dependencies through developing leading-edge manufacturing capabilities and material substitutes, patenting activity in renewable technologies is declining. Additionally, the sector faces potential skills shortages in engineering and technical trades. The findings suggest successful renewable energy deployment requires coordinated policy approaches addressing innovation support, supply chain resilience, and workforce development.
abstract_zh: 尽管可再生能源的采用在全球范围内加速推进，但要实现雄心勃勃的部署目标，仍面临重大挑战。本文通过考察贸易、创新、并购、就业和技能数据，分析了可再生能源生态系统中的瓶颈，并探讨了政策解决方案。分析揭示了三项关键发现：第一，可再生能源生态系统跨越电力生产之外的多个部门，其中机械、计算机与电子产品以及科学和技术活动在创新活动和就业创造中发挥着核心作用；第二，资本品和关键原材料的供应链集中度正在上升，形成了对关键供应国的依赖；第三，虽然创新可以通过发展领先的制造能力和材料替代品来缓解这些依赖，但可再生技术的专利活动正在下降。此外，该行业还面临工程和技术工种的潜在技能短缺。研究结果表明，成功部署可再生能源需要协调一致的政策方法，同时解决创新支持、供应链韧性和劳动力发展等问题。

title: Estonia's firm-level production network: Lessons for industrial policy
What is the role of Government Venture Capital for innovation-driven entrepreneurship?
Designing policy packages for a climate-neutral industry: A case study from the Netherlands
Do tax incentives for research increase firm innovation? An RD design for R&D
Imported carbon emissions: Evidence from French manufacturing companies
abstract: This paper analyzes imported carbon emission at the firm level. To do so, we combine information on emissions, imports, imported emissions and energy prices for French manufacturing firms between 1997 and 2014. We document a significant increase of the carbon emissions embedded in imports of French manufacturing companies over the period 1997 to 2014 that is attributable mainly to a shift towards more carbon‐intensive products and countries. We then estimate the impact of imported emissions on domestic emissions and emission intensity using a shift‐share instrumental variable strategy based on third countries supply shocks. We do not find compelling evidence of an impact of carbon imports on total emissions, but emission efficiency improves significantly in companies offshoring emissions abroad. A 10% increase in carbon offshoring causes a 4% decline in emission intensity. In addition, we find that the elasticity of domestic emission intensity to imported emissions is stronger in energy‐intensive sectors, on high‐productivity companies and among exporters. Reassuringly, the relationship between imported emissions and emission intensity does not seem to be driven by a pollution haven motive.
abstract_zh: 本文在企业层面分析了进口碳排放。为此，我们结合了1997至2014年间法国制造业企业的排放、进口、进口排放和能源价格信息。我们记录到，1997至2014年间，法国制造业企业进口中所含的碳排放显著增加，这主要归因于进口向碳密集度更高的产品和国家转移。随后，我们采用基于第三国供给冲击的份额—移动工具变量策略，估计进口排放对国内排放和排放强度的影响。我们并未发现碳进口对总排放产生有说服力影响的证据，但在将排放转移到国外的企业中，排放效率显著提高。碳外包增加10%，将导致排放强度下降4%。此外，我们发现，国内排放强度对进口排放的弹性在能源密集型行业、高生产率企业以及出口企业中更强。令人欣慰的是，进口排放与排放强度之间的关系似乎并非由“污染避难所”动机所驱动。

title: Industrial strategies for Europe's green transition
venue: Sparking Europe's New Industrial Revolution (Bruegel Blueprint)

title: Invention and Global Diffusion of Technologies for Climate Change Adaptation: A Patent Analysis
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: In addition to greenhouse gas mitigation efforts, the global economy will need adaptation technology to function in a changing climate. In this article, we use patent data to describe the global pace of innovation in climate adaptation technology. We identify the leading countries, track technology diffusion across borders, and relate innovation trends to adaptation needs. We find that innovation in adaptation technology has developed less rapidly than innovation in low-carbon technologies since 2005. This seems mainly due to the fact that adaptation is more important in sectors where the overall pace of innovation is slower than average, such as agriculture. Moreover, innovation is highly concentrated, with China, Germany, Japan, South Korea, and the United States accounting for nearly two-thirds of global patented inventions that are relevant to climate adaptation. Other economies could benefit through international technology transfer, but we find only limited technology diffusion through the patent system. International diffusion is particularly low in agriculture and flood protection, and there is virtually no transfer of the relevant patented knowledge to low-income countries. As a result, we find a striking mismatch between countries’ adaptation needs and technological availability.
abstract_zh: 除温室气体减排努力之外，全球经济还需要适应性技术，以便在气候变化中正常运转。本文利用专利数据，描述了气候适应技术全球创新的步伐。我们识别了领先国家，追踪了技术跨境扩散的情况，并将创新趋势与适应需求联系起来。我们发现，自2005年以来，适应技术的创新发展速度低于低碳技术。这主要是因为，适应在整体创新速度低于平均水平的部门（如农业）中更为重要。此外，创新高度集中，中国、德国、日本、韩国和美国合计占全球与气候适应相关的专利发明的近三分之二。其他经济体本可以通过国际技术转让受益，但我们发现，通过专利体系实现的技术扩散十分有限。在农业和防洪领域，国际扩散尤其低，而相关专利知识几乎未向低收入国家转让。因此，我们发现各国的适应需求与技术可得性之间存在显著错配。

title: The Joint Impact of the EU ETS on Carbon Emissions and Economic Performance
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Directed technical change and environmental economics
Mortality Inequality, Temperature, and Public Health Provision: Evidence from Mexico
abstract: We examine the impact of temperature on mortality in Mexico using daily data over the period 1998–2017 and find that 3.8 percent of deaths in Mexico are caused by suboptimal temperature (26,000 every year). However, 92 percent of weather-related deaths are induced by cold (32°C). Furthermore, temperatures are twice as likely to kill people in the bottom half of the income distribution. Finally, we show causal evidence that the Seguro Popular, a universal health care policy, has saved at least 1,600 lives per year from cold weather since 2004. (JEL I12, I13, I14, O13, O15, Q54)
abstract_zh: 我们利用1998至2017年的每日数据，考察了温度对墨西哥死亡率的影响，发现墨西哥3.8%的死亡是由非最适温度造成的（每年约26,000人）。然而，与天气相关的死亡中有92%是由寒冷（低于最适温度）引起的。此外，温度对收入分布底部一半人群致死的可能性是其他人群的两倍。最后，我们提供了因果证据，表明全民医保政策“人民保险”（Seguro Popular）自2004年以来已每年至少挽救了1,600人免于寒冷天气致死。（JEL I12, I13, I14, O13, O15, Q54）

title: Searching for carbon leaks in multinational companies
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Does a unilateral climate change policy cause companies to shift the location of production, thereby creating carbon leakage? In this paper, we analyze the effect of the European Union Emissions Trading System (EU ETS) on the geographic distribution of carbon emissions by multinational companies. The empirical evidence is based on unique data for the period 2007–2014 from the Carbon Disclosure Project, which tracks the emissions of multinational businesses by geographic region within each company. Because they already operate from multiple locations, multinational firms should be the most prone to carbon leakage. Our data includes the regional emissions of 1,122 companies, of which 261 are subject to EU ETS regulation. We find no evidence that the EU ETS has led to a displacement of carbon emissions from Europe toward the rest of the world, including to countries with lax climate policies and within energy-intensive companies. A large number of robustness checks confirm this finding. Overall, the paper suggests that modest differences in carbon prices between countries do not induce carbon leakage.
abstract_zh: 单边气候变化政策是否会促使企业转移生产地点，从而产生碳泄漏？本文分析了欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）对跨国公司碳排放地理分布的影响。实证证据基于碳信息披露项目（CDP）2007至2014年间的独特数据，该数据按地理区域追踪了跨国企业在各公司内部的排放情况。由于这些企业已经在多个地点运营，跨国企业理应最容易发生碳泄漏。我们的数据包括1,122家公司的区域排放数据，其中261家受欧盟排放交易体系监管。我们没有发现证据表明，欧盟排放交易体系导致了碳排放从欧洲转移到世界其他地区，包括转移到气候政策宽松的国家，以及能源密集型企业内部的转移。大量稳健性检验证实了这一发现。总体而言，本文表明，各国之间碳价格的适度差异并不会引发碳泄漏。

title: The impact of intellectual property rights protection on low-carbon trade and foreign direct investments
Measuring and assessing the effects of climate policy uncertainty
Measuring environmental policy stringency in OECD countries: An update of the OECD composite EPS indicator
abstract: As countries implement stricter environmental policies, the need for tools to compare countries’ environmental policy stringency is becoming more pressing. The OECD Environmental Policy Stringency (EPS) index has become a widely used tool for policy analysis since its creation in 2014. This paper updates the EPS index over three decades from 1990 to 2020, across 40 countries and 13 policy instruments, focussing on climate change and air pollution mitigation policies. It up-grades the index structure across all years, adding a new sub-index that measures the strength of technology support policies, which complements the existing structure of market based and non-market based sub-indices. The paper shows evolving developments – across countries and time – in the stringency of environmental policies.
abstract_zh: 随着各国实施更为严格的环境政策，比较各国环境政策严格程度的工具变得愈发迫切。自2014年创建以来，经合组织环境政策严格度（EPS）指数已成为政策分析中广泛使用的工具。本文对EPS指数进行了更新，涵盖1990至2020年三十年间40个国家及13种政策工具，重点关注气候变化和空气污染缓解政策。本文在所有年份中升级了指数结构，新增了一个衡量技术支持政策强度的分项指数，与现有的市场型和非市场型分项指数形成互补。本文展示了各国在不同时期环境政策严格程度的演变情况。

title: Does the Market Value Clean Innovation? Evidence from US Listed Firms
venue: Applied Operations Research and Financial Modelling in Energy

title: Global trends in the invention and diffusion of climate change mitigation technologies
abstract: Increasing the development and diffusion of low-carbon technologies on a global scale is critical to mitigating climate change. Based on over two million patents from 1995 to 2017 from 106 countries in all major climate mitigation technologies, our analysis shows an annual average low-carbon patenting growth rate of 10 percent from 1995 to 2013. Yet, from 2013 to 2017 low-carbon patenting rates have fallen by around 6 percent annually, likely driven by declining fossil fuel prices and, possibly, a readjustment of investors’ expectations and a stagnation of public funding for green R&D after the financial crisis. The Paris Agreement does not appear to have reversed the negative trend in low-carbon patenting observed since 2013. Innovation is still highly concentrated, with Germany, Japan, and the US accounting for more than half of global inventions, and the top 10 countries for around 90%. This concentration has further intensified over the last decade. Except for China, emerging economies have not caught up and remain less specialised in low-carbon technologies than the world average. This underscores the need for more technology transfers to developing and emerging economies, where most of the future CO2-emissions increases are set to occur. Existing transfer mechanisms, such as the UN Technology Transfer Mechanism and the Clean Development Mechanism, appear insufficient given the slow progress of technology transfer.
abstract_zh: 在全球范围内推动低碳技术的研发与扩散，对于减缓气候变化至关重要。基于1995至2017年间来自106个国家、涵盖所有主要气候减缓技术领域的200多万项专利，我们的分析表明，1995至2013年间低碳专利申请的年均增长率为10%。然而，2013至2017年间，低碳专利申请率每年下降约6%，这可能是由化石燃料价格下跌、投资者预期的重新调整以及金融危机后绿色研发公共资金停滞所致。《巴黎协定》似乎并未扭转2013年以来低碳专利的负面趋势。创新仍高度集中：德国、日本和美国合计占全球发明的一半以上，前十名国家约占90%。在过去十年中，这种集中度进一步加剧。除中国外，新兴经济体并未赶上，其在低碳技术上的专业化程度仍低于世界平均水平。这凸显了向发展中和新兴经济体进行更多技术转让的必要性，因为未来大部分二氧化碳排放增长将发生在这些地区。现有的转让机制，例如《联合国气候变化框架公约》下的技术转让机制和清洁发展机制，鉴于技术转让进展缓慢，似乎并不充分。

title: Induced innovation in energy technologies and systems: A review of evidence and potential implications for CO₂ mitigation
Is firm-level clean or dirty innovation valued more?
Assessing the impact of energy prices on plant-level environmental and economic performance: Evidence from Indonesian manufacturers
Assessing the efficiency of environmental policy design and evaluation: Results from a 2018 cross-country survey
The effect of energy prices and environmental policy stringency on manufacturing employment in OECD countries
Do Environmental and Economic Performance Go Together? A Review of Micro-level Empirical Evidence from the Past Decade or So
venue: International Review of Environmental and Resource Economics
abstract: This article reviews the empirical literature combining economic and environmental performance data at the micro-level, i.e. firm or facility level. The literature has generally found a positive and statistically significant correlation between economic performance, as measured by profitability indicators or stock market returns, and environmental performance, as measured by emissions of pollutants or adoption of international environmental standards. The main reason for this finding seems to be that firms that reduce their material and energy costs experience both better economic performance and lower emissions. Only a small and recent literature analyses the joint causal impact of environmental regulations on environmental and economic performance. Interestingly, this literature shows that environmental regulations tend to improve environmental performance while not weakening economic performance. However, the evidence so far is limited to a handful of environmental regulations that are not extremely stringent, so the result cannot be easily generalized. More research is needed to assess the joint effects of environmental regulations on environmental and economic performance, to explore the heterogeneity of these effects across sectors, countries and types of policies, and to understand which policy designs allow improving environmental quality while not coming at a cost in terms of economic performance of regulated businesses.
abstract_zh: 本文回顾了在微观层面（即企业或设施层面）结合经济绩效与环境绩效数据的实证文献。文献普遍发现，以盈利指标或股票市场回报衡量的经济绩效，与以污染物排放或采用国际环境标准衡量的环境绩效之间存在正向且统计上显著的相关关系。造成这一发现的主要原因似乎在于，降低物料和能源成本的企业，既获得了更好的经济绩效，也实现了更低的排放。只有少量较新的文献分析了环境规制对环境绩效和经济绩效的联合因果影响。有趣的是，这类文献表明，环境规制往往能够改善环境绩效，同时不会削弱经济绩效。然而，目前的证据仅限于少数并不十分严格的环境规制，因此其结论不易推广。未来仍需进一步研究，以评估环境规制对环境绩效和经济绩效的联合效应，探究这些效应在不同行业、国家和政策类型之间的异质性，并明确哪些政策设计能够在改善环境质量的同时，不以受规制企业的经济绩效为代价。

title: The economic cost of air pollution: Evidence from Europe
abstract: This study provides the first evidence that air pollution causes economy-wide reductions in market economic activity based on data for Europe. The analysis combines satellite-based measures of air pollution with statistics on regional economic activity at the NUTS-3 level throughout the European Union over the period 2000-15. An instrumental variables approach based on thermal inversions is used to identify the causal impact of air pollution on economic activity. The estimates show that a 1μg/m3 increase in PM2.5 concentration (or a 10% increase at the sample mean) causes a 0.8% reduction in real GDP that same year. Ninety-five per cent of this impact is due to reductions in output per worker, which can occur through greater absenteeism at work or reduced labour productivity. Therefore, the results suggest that public policies to reduce air pollution may contribute positively to economic growth. Indeed, the large economic benefits from pollution reduction uncovered in the study compare with relatively small abatement costs. Thus, more stringent air quality regulations could be warranted based solely on economic grounds, even ignoring the large benefits in terms of avoided mortality.
abstract_zh: 本研究首次提供了证据，表明在欧洲，空气污染会导致整体市场经济活动的减少。分析将卫星测量的空气污染数据与欧盟各地2000至2015年间NUTS-3层级的地区经济活动统计相结合。我们采用基于逆温层的工具变量方法，识别空气污染对经济活动的因果影响。估计结果表明，PM2.5浓度每增加1μg/m3（相当于样本均值的10%），当年实际GDP便减少0.8%。这一影响的95%源于人均产出的减少，而这种减少可能通过更多的工作缺勤或劳动生产率下降而发生。因此，研究结果表明，减少空气污染的公共政策可能对经济增长产生积极作用。事实上，本研究揭示的减污所带来的巨大经济效益，与相对较小的减排成本相比显得十分可观。因此，即使不考虑避免死亡所带来的巨大收益，仅基于经济理由，也可能需要更严格的空气质量法规。

title: Fiscal and Regulatory Instruments for Clean Technology Development in the European Union
venue: Energy Tax and Regulatory Policy in Europe

title: International patent families: from application strategies to statistical indicators
The impacts of environmental regulations on competitiveness
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: This article reviews the empirical literature on the impacts of environmental regulations on firms’ competitiveness as measured by trade, industry location, employment, productivity, and innovation. The evidence shows that environmental regulations can lead to statistically significant adverse effects on trade, employment, plant location, and productivity in the short run, in particular in a well-identified subset of pollution- and energy-intensive sectors, but that these impacts are small relative to general trends in production. At the same time, there is evidence that environmental regulations induce innovation in clean technologies, but the resulting benefits do not appear to be large enough to outweigh the costs of regulations for the regulated entities. As measures to address competitiveness impacts are increasingly incorporated into the design of environmental regulations, future research will be needed to assess the validity and effectiveness of such measures and to ensure they are compatible with the environmental objectives of the policies.
abstract_zh: 本文回顾了关于环境规制对企业竞争力影响的实证文献，竞争力以贸易、产业布局、就业、生产率和创新来衡量。证据表明，环境规制在短期内可能对贸易、就业、工厂选址和生产率产生具有统计显著性的不利影响，尤其集中在一小部分界定清晰的污染密集型和能源密集型行业，但相对于总体生产趋势而言，这些影响较小。与此同时，有证据表明，环境规制能够促进清洁技术创新，但由此产生的收益似乎不足以抵消受规制主体所承担的成本。随着应对竞争力影响的措施越来越多地被纳入环境规制的设计之中，未来的研究需要评估这些措施的有效性与适用性，并确保它们与政策的环境目标相兼容。

title: What role for climate negotiations on technology transfer?
abstract: Little progress has been made in climate negotiations on technology since 1992. Yet the diffusion of climate change mitigation technologies to developing countries (non-Annex I) has increased dramatically over the last twenty years. The shift has mostly concerned emerging economies, which are now reasonably well connected to international technology flows. This is good news, as the bulk of emissions increases are expected to take place in these countries in the near future. In contrast, the least developed countries still appear to be excluded from international technology flows, mostly because of their negligible participation in the recent economic globalization. This article focuses on the policy implications of the contribution of climate negotiations to international technology diffusion. Policy relevanceThe discrepancy between the small amount of progress made in climate negotiations on technology since 1992 and the steady increase in the international diffusion of climate mitigation technologies leads to the perhaps controversial view that the diffusion of climate mitigation technologies does not need strong international coordination over technology issues under the UNFCCC. However, climate negotiations can play a key role in stimulating the demand for low-carbon technologies by setting ambitious emission reductions targets and policies.
abstract_zh: 自1992年以来，气候谈判在技术议题上进展甚微。然而，过去二十年间，气候变化减缓技术向发展中国家（非附件I国家）的扩散急剧增加。这一转变主要发生在新兴经济体，它们目前已较好地融入国际技术流动之中。这是个好消息，因为未来不久大部分排放增长预计将发生在这些国家。相比之下，最不发达国家似乎仍被排除在国际技术流动之外，主要原因在于它们在近期经济全球化中几乎没有参与。本文聚焦于气候谈判对国际技术扩散的贡献所蕴含的政策含义。政策相关性：自1992年以来，气候谈判在技术议题上取得的进展微乎其微，而气候减缓技术的国际扩散却稳步增长，这一反差引出了一个或许颇具争议的观点，即在《联合国气候变化框架公约》下，气候减缓技术的扩散并不需要在技术问题上进行强有力的国际协调。然而，气候谈判可以通过设定雄心勃勃的减排目标和政策，在刺激低碳技术需求方面发挥关键作用。

title: Knowledge spillovers from clean and dirty technologies
Understanding the dynamics of global value chains for solar photovoltaic technologies
abstract: China dominates the global solar photovoltaic (PV) value chain, while 15 years ago the demand and supply were located in few Western economies. In this process, the PV industry has seen a booming demand, drastic price decreases along the supply chain, and fierce competition among surviving companies. This paper seeks to understand how this spatial shift has occurred and its drivers, with a specific focus on the role of intangible assets and intellectual property.
abstract_zh: 中国主导着全球太阳能光伏（PV）价值链，而在15年前，需求与供给主要集中在少数西方经济体。在这一过程中，光伏产业经历了需求的蓬勃增长、供应链各环节价格的急剧下降，以及幸存企业之间的激烈竞争。本文旨在理解这一空间转移是如何发生的及其驱动因素，并特别关注无形资产和知识产权的作用。

title: Carbon Taxes, Path Dependency and Directed Technical Change: Evidence from the Auto Industry
abstract: Can directed technical change be used to combat climate change? We construct new firm-level panel data on auto industry innovation distinguishing between “dirty" (internal combustion engine) and “clean" (e.g. electric and hybrid) patents across 80 countries over several decades. We show that firms tend to innovate relatively more in clean technologies when they face higher tax-inclusive fuel prices. Furthermore, there is path dependence in the type of innovation both from aggregate spillovers and from the firm's own innovation history. Using our model we simulate the increases in carbon taxes needed to allow clean to overtake dirty technologies.
abstract_zh: 定向技术变革能否用于应对气候变化？我们构建了一套新的汽车行业企业层面面板数据，区分了80个国家数十年间的“肮脏”（内燃机）专利与“清洁”（如电动和混合动力）专利。我们表明，当企业面临更高的含税燃料价格时，它们往往会更多地在清洁技术上进行创新。此外，创新类型存在路径依赖，这既来自总体层面的溢出效应，也来自企业自身的创新历史。利用我们的模型，我们模拟了使清洁技术超越肮脏技术所需的碳税提高幅度。

title: Environmental Policy and Directed Technological Change: Evidence from the European carbon market
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of the European Union Emissions Trading System (EU ETS) on technological change, exploiting installations level inclusion criteria to estimate the System’s causal impact on firms’ patenting. We find that the EU ETS has increased low-carbon innovation among regulated firms by as much as 10%, while not crowding out patenting for other technologies. We also find evidence that the EU ETS has not affected patenting beyond the set of regulated companies. These results imply that the EU ETS accounts for nearly a 1% increase in European low-carbon patenting compared to a counterfactual scenario.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）对技术变革的影响，利用设施层面的纳入标准来估计该体系对企业专利申请的因果效应。我们发现，欧盟排放交易体系使受监管企业的低碳创新增加了多达10%，同时并未挤出其他技术的专利申请。我们还发现，该体系并未对受监管企业范围之外的专利申请产生影响。这些结果意味着，与反事实情景相比，欧盟排放交易体系使欧洲低碳专利申请增加了近1%。

title: Asymmetric industrial energy prices and international trade
abstract: This paper measures the response of bilateral trade flows to differences in industrial energy prices across countries. Using a rich panel dataset with 42 countries, 62 manufacturing sectors over 16 years (1996–2011) and covering 60% of global merchandise trade, we estimate the short-run effects of sector-level energy price asymmetry on trade. We find that changes in relative energy prices have a statistically significant but very small impact on imports. On average, a 10% increase in the energy price difference between two country-sectors increases imports by 0.2%. The impact is larger for energy-intensive sectors. Even in these sectors, however, the magnitude of the effect is such that changes in energy price differences across time explain less than 0.01% of the variation in trade flows. Simulations based on our model predict that a €40–65/tCO2 price of carbon in the EU ETS would increase Europe's imports from the rest of the world by less than 0.05% and decrease exports by 0.2%.
abstract_zh: 本文衡量了双边贸易流量对各国间工业能源价格差异的反应。我们利用一个丰富的面板数据集，涵盖42个国家、62个制造业部门、1996至2011年间的16年数据，该数据集覆盖了全球商品贸易的60%，我们估计了部门层面能源价格不对称对贸易的短期效应。我们发现，相对能源价格的变化对进口具有统计上显著但非常微小的影响。平均而言，两个国家—部门之间能源价格差异增加10%，进口仅增加0.2%。能源密集型部门的影响较大。然而，即便在这些部门中，效应的规模也仅使得跨时间的能源价格差异变化只能解释贸易流量变动的不到0.01%。基于我们模型的模拟预测，欧盟排放交易体系中每吨二氧化碳40至65欧元的碳价格，将使欧洲从世界其他地区的进口增加不到0.05%，并使出口减少0.2%。

title: Invention and diffusion of water supply and water efficiency technologies: Insights from a global patent dataset
abstract: This paper identifies over 50,000 patents filed worldwide in various water-related technologies between 1990 and 2010, distinguishing between those related to availability (supply) and conservation (demand) technologies. Patenting activity is analyzed — including inventive activity by country and technology, international diffusion of such water-related technologies, and international collaboration in technology development. Three results stand out from our analysis. First, although inventive activity in water-related technologies has been increasing over the last two decades, this growth has been disproportionately concentrated on supply-side technologies. Second, whilst 80% of water-related invention occurs worldwide in countries with low or moderate water scarcity, several countries with absolute or chronic water scarcity are relatively specialized in water efficiency technologies. Finally, although we observe a positive association between water scarcity and local filings of water patents, some countries with high water availability, in particular Switzerland or Norway, nevertheless appear as significant markets for water-efficiency technologies. This suggests that drivers other than local demand, like regulation and social and cultural factors, play a role in explaining the global flows of technologies.
abstract_zh: 本文识别了1990至2010年间全球提交的50,000多项水相关技术专利，并区分了与供水（供给侧）和节水（需求侧）相关的技术。分析内容包括各国和各技术领域的发明活动、水相关技术的国际扩散，以及技术开发中的国际合作。分析中有三项结果尤为突出。第一，尽管过去二十年水相关技术的发明活动一直在增长，但这一增长在很大程度上集中于供给侧技术。第二，虽然全球80%的水相关发明发生在水资源稀缺程度低或中等的国家，但若干存在绝对或长期水资源短缺的国家，在节水技术上却具有相对专业化的优势。第三，尽管我们观察到水资源稀缺程度与本地水专利申请之间存在正相关关系，但一些水资源丰富的国家（特别是瑞士或挪威）仍然是节水技术的重要市场。这表明，除当地需求之外，监管以及社会和文化因素等其他驱动力，在解释全球技术流动方面也发挥着作用。

title: Regulatory distance and the transfer of new environmentally sound technologies: Evidence from the automobile sector
Does foreign environmental policy influence domestic inventors? Evidence from the wind industry
L'innovation technologique face au changement climatique : quelle est la position de la France ?
abstract:
Technological Innovation and Climate Change : Where Does France Stand ?
We analyse France’s position on global warming mitigation technology. The methodology draws on a database describing all patents filed between 1980 and 2008 in 17 climate-related technological classes. France is the fifth largest innovator in theworld, with 5.2% of patented inventions, including 20% from the public sector. More than half of French inventions are protected abroad, 1.5 times more than the global average. France’s position is relativelyweak in renewable energy, and strong in sectorsmarked by the presence of national industrial champions and public research organisations.
abstract_zh:
技术创新与气候变化：法国处于什么位置？
本文分析了法国在全球变暖减缓技术方面的地位。研究方法基于一个数据库，该数据库涵盖了1980至2008年间在17个气候相关技术类别中提交的所有专利。法国是世界第五大创新国，占已获专利发明的5.2%，其中20%来自公共部门。法国超过一半的发明在国外获得保护，这一比例是全球平均水平的1.5倍。法国在可再生能源领域的地位相对较弱，而在以国家工业巨头和公共研究机构为特征的部门中则较为强势。

title: What Drives the International Transfer of Climate Change Mitigation Technologies? Empirical Evidence from Patent Data
abstract: Using patent data from 66 countries for the period 1990–2003, we characterize the factors which promote or hinder the international diffusion of climate-friendly technologies on a global scale. Regression results show that technology-specific capabilities of the recipient countries are determinant factors. In contrast, the general level of education is less important. We also show that restrictions to international trade — e.g., high tariff rates — and lax intellectual property regimes negatively influence the international diffusion of patented knowledge. A counter-intuitive result is that barriers to foreign direct investments can promote transfers. We discuss different possible interpretations.
abstract_zh: 利用1990至2003年间66个国家的专利数据，我们刻画了促进或阻碍气候友好技术在全球范围内国际扩散的因素。回归结果表明，接收国的技术专门能力是决定性因素。相比之下，一般教育水平则不那么重要。我们还表明，国际贸易限制（例如高关税）和宽松的知识产权制度会对专利知识的国际扩散产生负面影响。一个反直觉的结果是，对外国直接投资的壁垒可能反而促进技术转移。我们讨论了几种可能的解释。

title: Who will win the green race? In search of environmental competitiveness and innovation
abstract: As the world considers greener forms of economic growth, countries and sectors are beginning to position themselves for the emerging green economy. This paper combines patent data with international trade and output data in order to investigate who the winners of this “green race” might be. The analysis covers 110 manufacturing sectors in eight countries (China, Germany, France, Italy, Japan, South Korea, UK and the US) using date for the period 2005–2007. We identify three success factors for green competitiveness at the sector level: the speed at which sectors convert to green products and processes (measured by green innovation), their ability to gain and maintain market share (measured by existing comparative advantages) and a favourable starting point (measured by current output). We find that the green race is likely to alter the present competitiveness landscape. Many incumbent country-sectors with strong comparative advantages today lag behind in terms of green conversion, suggesting that they could lose their competitive edge. Japan, and to a lesser extent Germany, appear best placed to benefit from the green economy, while other European countries (Italy in particular) could fall behind. However, the green economy is much broader than the few flagship sectors on which the debate tends to focus, and each country has its niches of green competitiveness.
abstract_zh: 随着世界考虑更为绿色的经济增长形式，各国和各部门正在为新兴的绿色经济进行定位。本文将专利数据与国际贸易和产出数据相结合，以探究谁可能成为这场“绿色竞赛”的赢家。分析涵盖八个国家（中国、德国、法国、意大利、日本、韩国、英国和美国）的110个制造业部门，使用的是2005至2007年的数据。我们确定了部门层面绿色竞争力的三个成功因素：部门向绿色产品和工艺转型的速度（以绿色创新衡量）、其获取并保持市场份额的能力（以现有比较优势衡量），以及有利的起点（以当前产出衡量）。我们发现，绿色竞赛很可能改变当前的竞争力格局。目前具有较强比较优势的许多国家—部门在绿色转型方面落后，表明它们可能失去竞争优势。日本，以及程度稍轻的德国，似乎最有能力从绿色经济中获益，而其他欧洲国家（尤其是意大利）则可能落后。然而，绿色经济远比辩论中常聚焦的少数旗舰部门广泛，每个国家都有其绿色竞争力的利基领域。
